question: On this day in 1960, Roger Maris won AL MVP over teammate Mickey Mantle, even though Mantle got more first-place votes (10 to 8). How many points did Maris win by?
question_short: Mantle got more first-place MVP votes in 1960. How many points did Maris beat him by?
answer_detail: Maris edged Mantle 225 to 222 on Nov. 9, 1960. Voters ranked ten players, so Maris's deeper ballot support outweighed Mantle's extra first-place votes. Maris won MVP again in 1961, his 61-homer year.
answer_short: Maris won 225 to 222, then won MVP again in 1961, his 61-homer year.
